Name: No Year 2 Price Increase Robin
Author: 4ihdf66
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Stone and Wood Price No Increase[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]Compatible with 1.6+, 1.6.15 tested [/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Requirements  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] , [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url]  
Copy files to "Stardew Valley\Mods\" [/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]This mod does not work by fixing the prices of the original wood and stone;
instead, it adds two new items to the very bottom of the item list in Robin's shop.

If you scroll the list down to the bottom, you will see the newly added wood and stone, as my sample image, which are available at a fixed price of 20. [/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url] [/color]
